_comment: Device frame assets vendored from fastlane/frameit-frames (MIT license: https://github.com/fastlane/frameit-frames). offsetX/offsetY/screenshotWidth are pixel values from that repo's offsets.json, in the frame PNG's own coordinate space (top-left corner + width to resize the raw screenshot to, before compositing it behind the frame). outputWidth/outputHeight are Apple's exact required App Store Connect screenshot pixel sizes for this device's display class (developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/screenshot-specifications) - the final composited PNG must match exactly, no tolerance.

iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)._comment: frameit-frames has no frame for this exact model yet; standing in with 'iPad Pro (12.9-inch) (4th generation)' - its screen aspect ratio (2048/2732 = 0.7496) is within 0.1% of the 13-inch M5's native ratio (2064/2752 = 0.7500), so the composite has no visible gap or distortion. outputWidth/outputHeight (2048x2732) is one of the two Apple-accepted '13-inch Display' sizes and happens to equal this frame's own native screenshot width, so no scaling mismatch either.
